pools.intro: The Ned Baumer Aquatic Center is adjacent to Hourglass Field Community Park . The Aquatic Center is a joint-use facility with Miramar Community College and consists of three pools. This facility is ideal for birthday parties, competitive swimming, water polo and synchronized swimming.
notes: Lane sharing and circle swimming are required.
Limited lap lanes during some scheduled programs. Please call ahead: (858) 538-8083.
Pool closed Saturdays and Sundays.
Pool closes December 12, 2026 for its annual closure, which lasts until Summer 2027.

pools.name: Standley Aquatic Center
pools.intro: The Standley Aquatic Center is a joint use facility with the San Diego Unified School District. The facility is located near Standley Recreation Center and Swanson Memorial Pool . This facility is ideal for competitive swimming, water polo and lap swimming.
notes: Limited lap lanes during some scheduled programs.
Lane sharing and circle swimming are required.
Please call ahead: (619) 605-2170.
Pool closed Saturdays.
All aquatics programs, schedules and fees may change or be cancelled without notice.

pools.name: Swanson Memorial Pool
pools.intro: The Swanson Memorial Pool is located in the University City community next to Standley Aquatic Center and Standley Park . The facility is a designated arthritis therapy pool with water temperatures near 85°F / 29°C. This facility is ideal for birthday parties.
notes: Lane sharing and circle swimming are required.
Lap lanes are limited during some scheduled programs; please call ahead: (858) 552-1653.
Pool is closed Saturdays, Sundays, and Mondays.

pools.name: Tierrasanta Community Pool
pools.address: 11238 Clairemont Mesa Bl, San Diego, CA 92124
pools.intro: The Tierrasanta Community Pool is located next to the Tierrasanta Recreation Center . This facility features a separate 2-foot-deep children's pool with a playground and water sprays. It is ideal for birthday parties, competitive swimming, water polo and synchronized swimming.

pools.name: Vista Terrace Pool
pools.intro: The Vista Terrace Pool is located in the San Ysidro community at Vista Terrace Park. This facility is ideal for birthday parties and competitive swimming.
